claims.statement: Retained: for the sorted positive-arm family with 1<=c<=6, sum_i m_i=2p+3-c, and p=10..13, exactly one tree is eligible; it is p=10 with profile (2,3,3,3,3,3), and its 17 favorable original leaves contribute a full sum S=-122805 with every summand negative.
claims.scope: Exact bounded census of the stated root-and-pendant-arms family only. This is not a census of all trees with vertex-cover number at most six and does not settle a universal shell or aggregate statement.
claims.reason: retained: an independent closed branch-product computation reproduces every family candidate count, both eligibility guards, the sole eligible tree, all 17 distinct tagged leaf terms, and the exact negative total. The c=1 root is correctly counted as an original leaf in this audit; those rows are ineligible and do not change the retained claim. The evidence remains finite and family-restricted.

limitations: The verified census is limited to the root with one to six centers, each carrying at least one pendant leaf, for p=10..13 and the stated order boundary.
The result neither covers all trees with cover number at most six nor establishes a general low-cover classification or singleton degree-budget reduction.
The computation gives no universal pointwise-sign or primary aggregate resolution; no primary-literature theorem was imported.
